title.narrative: DRK/IFRC humanitarian appeal for support to Türkiye 2023

description.narrative:
The support will contribute to Turkish Red Crescent’s capacity to e.g. - Provide shelter including tents, blankets, sleeping bags, bed chairs, mattresses, heaters, tarpaulins, lanterns and kitchen sets - As part of the immediate response to basic needs provide hot food and distribute food parcels and cash support - Provide urgent MHPSS and distribute hygiene kits - Utilise call centres, crisis coordination centres, communicate information via SMS and include PSEA policies as part of training for staff and volunteers to ensure no unintentional harm takes place on the field
Annual report will be published online: https://www.ifrc.org/our-promise/trust-and-accountability/annual-report

Through IFRC’s global humanitarian appeal, support to deploy basecamp units of Danish Red cross as well as support Turkish Red Cross’ work in Türkiye. Providing urgent and lifesaving emergency aid to Türkiye following the earthquakes that hit on February 6, 2023.
